कह्लारं The white lotus,
कह्लारपद्मकुसुमानि मुहुर्विधुन्वन्

काहका A kind of musical
instrument.

काहल a.
1 Dry, withered.
--2
Mischievous.
--3 Excessive, spacious,
large.
--लः
1 A cat.
--2 A cock.
--3 A crow.
--4 A sound in
general.
--लं
1 Indistinct speech.
--2 A kind of musical instrument;
Śi. 18. 54.
--लं ind. Very much,
excessively; Śi. 18. 54.
--ला A large drum
(military).
--ली A young woman.
--लः, --ला, --लं A horn.
